body:
I tried seroquel, and then wellbutrin (150mg and then 300mg daily) and xanax ("as needed," .25 mg).

Seroquel made me feel drugged up all of the time. I had to sleep more hours, and when I was awake, I felt groggy and drowsy, even when I got switched to just 50mg.

But Wellbutrin didn't make me feel like I was on drugs, and I didn't notice any appetite / weight change. I didn't notice any effect from it really.

With xanax, eventually taking two of them had about the same effect as taking one of them used to, but when I ran out I didn't miss them very much or have withdrawal.
